basic_info.description: Located on a premier block in Presidio Heights, 3471 Jackson Street is a beautifully renovated, house-like condominium in a boutique three-unit building. This refined 3BD/3BA home offers generous proportions, classic San Francisco architectural detail, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. The spacious floor plan features a grand living room with fireplace, formal dining area, and a chef's kitchen with premium appliances including Viking, Sub-Zero, and Miele. Three bedrooms and two full baths are on one level, including a serene primary suite with en suite bath and garden outlooks. A flexible lower-level bonus space with full bath offers ideal use for an office, gym, or guest area. Enjoy direct access to a deeded private garden and the rare convenience of a private side-by-side 2-car garage. All set just moments from the Presidio, Laurel Village, and Sacramento Street shopping.
